sequence: five repeated generations with identical feedback/model/runtime
one evidence-supported execution repair with unchanged candidate
freeze execution; three feedback-informed round2 candidates
freeze selected strategies; five previously unexposed layouts

stage1.tie_break: retain incumbent when tied; among strictly improved ties use earliest generation order
stage1.rejected_candidates: report as rejected/no native outcome, never score0 or replace

stage2.design: fixed candidate paired control; one changed execution factor, five exposed layouts per condition
stage2.variable_selection: use earliest common transport/placement failure with supporting raw events; document intervention before execution
stage2.acceptance: mechanistic change and native score separately; if no native benefit preserve baseline executor for confirmatory comparisons

stage3.feedback: one fixed packet of stage1 selected-parent execution evidence under frozen final execution
stage3.candidate_budget_comparison: first candidate vs best of first five, same dev selection rule and executor; best across round2 separately labeled feedback+additional search
stage3.continuous_rounds: two generation/validation/selection rounds; parent retained on non-improvement

heldout.eligibility: not in previous task-specific diagnostic/validation manifests or feedback; provenance audit before use

fixed: candidate source and generated memory immutable after generation
no training; no privileged simulator state in policy
limitations: small exploratory pilot; five exposed layouts per candidate are not independent candidate×layout observations
current GPT high and corrected executor do not isolate historical Qwen candidate scarcity
no causal credit for candidate count if execution changed; compare candidate budgets after same-runtime revalidation
success/scoring and single-object delivery distinct; cleanup release distinct from normal completion
